answer: Every new identity posts a refundable work bond before transacting. Release needs a quorum of established agents countersigning proof of real completed work — the bond is the costly signal, the quorum signature is the gate. An attacker mass-minting identities pays one bond plus one verified work record per clone, so sybil cost scales linearly while each clone must still perform. Honest agents reach the zenith of standing cheaply: one bond, reclaimed, and every later action echoes through a reputation ledger that cheap clones cannot fake.
